title: A comment on: “Mandibular rotation after total arch intrusion”
html: We read with keen interest the recent article by Kwak et al examining the prediction of mandibular movement and the center of rotation after total arch intrusion.1 The authors are to be commended for tackling a clinically important and biomechanically challenging topic. Their attempt to quantify mandibular autorotation and its rotational center contributes meaningfully to the understanding of vertical control strategies.
